market_name: Will China invade Taiwan by end of 2026?

time_plan.30m: Check whether the probability move persists or reverts; look for any concurrent news headlines (PLA activity, official statements) that would validate the leak vs. noise.
time_plan.1h: Compare EWT/TSM ADR premarket or intraday move against the size of the probability shift; check VIX and gold for corroborating risk-off.
time_plan.2h: Assess whether Asian FX (TWD, CNH) and regional indices (Nikkei, KOSPI) confirm a coordinated risk-off consistent with genuine escalation.
time_plan.6h: Re-evaluate if move is fading; distinguish a one-off market glitch from a real geopolitical repricing by cross-checking Reuters/official sources.
time_plan.12h: Final check: did EWT/TSM close meaningfully lower with news confirmation, or did the probability spike and asset move both mean-revert (false signal)?

predictions.reasoning: A sharp upward move in the implied probability of a China invasion of Taiwan would price in existential risk to the most directly exposed liquid vehicle: Taiwan equities. EWT is dominated by TSMC and Taiwan tech/financials, all of which would sell off violently on any credible escalation signal. The move is highly asymmetric — invasion risk is a fat left tail. Only a truly large, sustained probability jump would produce a >700bp move; ordinary noise in a low-base-rate market will not.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check gold spot and DXY reaction; confirm whether any safe-haven bid is materializing alongside the probability move.
time_plan.1h: Cross-check gold move against Treasuries and JPY to see if a broad haven bid is genuine vs. isolated.
time_plan.2h: Assess persistence; a real escalation should sustain haven flows, noise should fade.
time_plan.6h: Re-check for confirming news and whether gold has extended or reverted.
time_plan.12h: Final assessment of whether gold held a haven bid tied to the event or reverted to macro drivers.

predictions.reasoning: A credible jump in Taiwan invasion odds would drive global risk-off flows into gold as a geopolitical hedge. However, gold's reaction to a Taiwan-specific scare is more muted and diffuse than the direct hit to Taiwan equities, and is easily swamped by rates/dollar dynamics. Reaching the 700bp threshold within 12h would require a major, confirmed escalation, so this is below the tradable bar in most cases.

evidence_used: Market question implies a low-base-rate geopolitical tail event (China invasion of Taiwan by end-2026)
Taiwan equities (EWT/TSM) are the most directly exposed liquid proxy to Taiwan conflict risk
Gold and safe havens historically bid on major geopolitical escalation
uncertainty_notes: Base rate of actual invasion is very low; most probability moves in this market are noise or thin-liquidity artifacts, not information leaks
A 12h window rarely captures the full repricing of a slow-burning geopolitical thesis unless there is a discrete triggering event
Proxy exposure is strong for EWT but confounded by broader tech/semiconductor and China macro flows
Gold reaction is diffuse and easily dominated by rates and dollar moves

llm_justification.summary: A sharp increase in the implied probability of a China invasion of Taiwan should transmit most cleanly to Taiwan equities (EWT/TSM) to the downside, with a secondary safe-haven bid into gold. The dominant, highest-conviction mapping is EWT down. Both mappings require a genuine, sizable probability jump to clear the 700bp tradable threshold; given the extremely low base rate, most observed moves are more likely noise than leaked information, so confidence is moderate at best.
key_assumptions: A material, sustained upward move in implied invasion probability reflects genuine risk repricing rather than thin-market noise
EWT/TSM remain the most liquid, directly exposed proxies and are open/tradable during the window
Markets have not already fully discounted the event when the probability move occurs
failure_modes: The probability spike is a low-liquidity Polymarket artifact and mean-reverts with no asset move (most likely failure)
Any real escalation may already be public via news, so no informational edge remains
EWT move is swamped by unrelated semiconductor/China macro flows, weakening the mapping
Gold fails to react due to offsetting dollar/rate strength
12h window closes before any slow geopolitical repricing plays out, producing a flat or reversed result
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
